info.title: v2.logistics.update_shipping_order
info.description: For pickup method only, use this api to update pickup address and pickup time for packages meet: 1) package's fulfillment status is LOGISTICS_PICKUP_RETRY; or 2) package's fulfillment status is 'LOGISTICS_REQUEST_CREATED' and meets the Instant Order Reschedule Pickup conditions.

post.description: For pickup method only, use this api to update pickup address and pickup time for packages meet: 1) package's fulfillment status is LOGISTICS_PICKUP_RETRY; or 2) package's fulfillment status is 'LOGISTICS_REQUEST_CREATED' and meets the Instant Order Reschedule Pickup conditions.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: address_id
parameters.description: The identity of address. Retrieved from get_shipping_parameter.

parameters.name: order_sn
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for an order.

parameters.name: package_number
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. You should't fill the field with empty string when there is't a package number.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: pickup
parameters.description: Required parameter ONLY if GetParameterForInit returns "pickup" or if GetLogisticsInfo returns "pickup" under "info_needed" for the same order. Developer should still include "pickup" field in the call even if "pickup" has empty value.

parameters.name: pickup_time_id
parameters.description: The pickup time id. Retrieved from get_shipping_parameter.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/update_shipping_order?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "order_sn": "201214JASXYXY6",
    "package_number": "-",
    "pickup": {
        "address_id": 126194,
        "pickup_time_id": "439291"
    }
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
